# Volume 1 timeline

## CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised

**[Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas](../character/thomas.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) notices [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) unexpectedly dressed up and driving out of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Curious about his unusual errand, she visits [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and learns that [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) has gone to [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) to pick up an orphan boy they are adopting from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia). Surprised and skeptical, Mrs. Rachel voices her deep misgivings before leaving to spread the astonishing news.

## CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised

**[Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Alexander Spencer](../character/alexander-spencer.md)** — [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) travels to [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) station expecting to pick up an orphan boy sent by Mrs. [Alexander Spencer](../character/alexander-spencer.md), but finds an eleven-year-old girl waiting instead. Unwilling to break the news of the mistake immediately, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) takes the talkative child into his buggy and begins driving her toward [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) as she converses lively about her imagination and life.

**[Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — As [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) drives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) toward [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she talks animatedly about her red hair and her love for beautiful landscapes. They pass through the blooming orchard-lined [Avenue](../codex/places.md#avenue), which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) renames the White Way of Delight, and cross near Barry's Pond, which she dubs the Lake of Shining Waters. Upon seeing [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) correctly identifies it as home, filling [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) with dread as he realizes the impending disappointment awaiting the young girl.

## CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) brings [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home, where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) expresses shock upon discovering she is a girl rather than the expected boy. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) breaks down in tears over being unwanted, introduces herself, and insists on being called [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with an 'E'. After a sorrowful supper, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to sleep in the east gable room, while [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) debate whether to keep her before deciding to see Mrs. [Spencer](../character/alexander-spencer.md) the next day.

## CHAPTER V. Anne’s History

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wakes up at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and admires the beautiful morning scenery from her bedroom window before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comes in to tell her to get dressed. During a quiet breakfast, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) chatter-talks until silenced, leaving [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) frustrated by both Anne's imaginative rambling and Matthew's silent desire to keep the girl. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps with chores, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prepares to drive her to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) to settle her return to [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia).

## CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — During their carriage ride down the shore road toward [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resolves to enjoy the journey and recounts her painful childhood history of being orphaned and passed between overworked families and an asylum. Listening to Anne's story, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) feels a sudden pang of pity and secretly considers whether they might actually keep her after all.

## CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers

**[Alexander Spencer](../character/alexander-spencer.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Blewett](../character/blewett.md), [Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrive at Mrs. Spencer's house to clarify the mix-up regarding the orphan child. When Mrs. [Blewett](../character/blewett.md) offers to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) hesitates after seeing Mrs. Blewett's harsh demeanor and Anne's distress, deciding instead to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back home to consult [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) to keep [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and adopt her.

## CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Thomas](../character/thomas.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to bed and instructs her on neatness and saying her prayers. After learning that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has never prayed before, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) instructs her to compose her own prayer, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivers in an unusual, formal manner. Afterwards, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns to the kitchen and tells [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) about Anne's lack of religious instruction, vowing to begin educating her immediately.

## CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) have decided to keep her at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), bringing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to overwhelmed, joyful tears. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) instructs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to memorize the Lord's Prayer, but catches her daydreaming in front of a painting in the sitting room. After discussing past imaginary friends and potential neighbors like [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is sent to her bedroom to finish memorizing the prayer, where she imagines lavish decor before settling happily into her new life as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) of [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

## CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and severely insults Anne's looks, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to fly into a furious rage and yell at her. After Mrs. Rachel leaves in an huff, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her bedroom and demands she apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) adamantly refuses.

## CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) secretly visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room and gently persuades her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) so she can leave her punishment. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dramatically apologizes to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), turning her penance into an enjoyable performance and earning Mrs. Lynde's forgiveness. As they walk back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) feels a surge of maternal affection for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

## CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Rogerson](../character/rogerson.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) shows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) her new clothes, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds disappointingly plain without puffed sleeves. The following morning, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) stays home sick while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decorates her hat with flowers and attends Sunday school alone. Upon returning, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) recounts her experiences at church and her impression of the service and her teacher, Miss [Rogerson](../character/rogerson.md).

## CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scolds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after hearing from [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) about her flower-decorated hat, but then brings her to meet [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). The two girls quickly become fast friends in the Barrys' garden and swear eternal friendship. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) joyfully shares the experience with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) delights her further by giving her a package of chocolates.

## CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) comes inside after being called by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and excitedly asks if she can go to the upcoming Sunday-school picnic. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees to let her go and promises to bake a basket of food for her, which prompts an affectionate hug from [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). While doing her patchwork, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talks enthusiastically about her and Diana's playhouse, [Idlewild](../codex/places.md#idlewild), and her intense anticipation for the picnic.

## CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) accuses [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) of losing her amethyst brooch and confines her to her room until she confesses. Desperate to attend the local picnic, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) fabricates a elaborate confession, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) still refuses to let her go. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discovers the brooch caught in her own shawl, realizes Anne's innocence, apologizes, and sends a overjoyed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) off to enjoy the picnic.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) admits her mistake, forgives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for the false confession, and sends her off to the picnic. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home overjoyed after a wonderful time and recounts the events to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), who later reflects on the incident with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).

## CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk through the scenic paths to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school while discussing their classmates, including [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) who has just returned. In class, Gilbert pulls Anne's red braid and calls her 'Carrots' to get her attention, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to smash her slate over his head in outrage. Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by making her stand at the blackboard, and despite Gilbert apologizing after school, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) coldly ignores him.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Tillie Boulter](../character/tillie-boulter.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — After Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) humiliates [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by forcing her to sit next to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), she rejects Gilbert's attempts to apologize and swears never to return to school. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consults Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who advises her to humor [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) until she cools down. Meanwhile, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) maintains her fierce grudge against Gilbert while weeping melodramatically over the thought of [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) eventually marrying and leaving her.

## CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) permission to invite [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) over for tea while she is away in [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) entertains [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), serving her three glasses of what she believes to be raspberry cordial, but [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) becomes severely dizzy and sick and has to leave. On Monday, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns from Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) accuses her of getting [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drunk, leading [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to discover that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) mistakenly served three-year-old currant wine.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tearfully explains to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) is furious with her for accidentally serving [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) currant wine instead of raspberry cordial and forbidding [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) from playing with her. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discovers she had put the wine in the wrong location and attempts to defend [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), but Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) refuses to be appeased. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) then personally begs Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) for forgiveness, but after being turned away, she returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) secretly shows her affection after she cries herself to sleep.

## CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Minnie Andrews](../character/minnie-andrews.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)** — [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) meets [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to say a dramatic goodbye, explaining that her mother forbids them from playing together, though the two exchange promises of eternal friendship. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school, where she is warmly welcomed back by her classmates and secretly exchanges notes with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) despite their enforced separation. Driven by a lingering grudge, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) throws herself into her studies to compete academically against [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), making impressive progress alongside him.

## CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Thomas](../character/thomas.md), [Young Mary Joe](../character/young-mary-joe.md)** — While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel attend a political rally in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) spend a quiet evening at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes in desperately seeking help because her little sister, [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), is dangerously ill with croup and their parents are away. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) uses her past experience with twins to treat [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), saving her life, which leads Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) to forgive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and allow her and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to be best friends once again.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Minnie Andrews](../character/minnie-andrews.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) has forgiven her and invited her to visit [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rushes over and later returns home overjoyed, recounting how Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) treated her like honored company and how she and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) renewed their friendship.

## CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Carrie Sloane](../character/carrie-sloane.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — After signaling [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) with candles, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) persuades [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)—with Matthew's quiet assistance—to let her stay overnight at Diana's and attend the [Debating Club](../codex/factions.md#debating-club) concert. At the concert, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys the performances but ignores [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) return home and leap into the spare-room bed, they inadvertently jump on Diana's elderly [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), causing a uproar that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later discusses with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — After discussing the bed-jumping incident with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to apologize directly to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). Anne's dramatic honesty and charm win over Miss [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), who decides to stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and continue paying for Diana's music lessons.

## CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)** — As spring turns into summer, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on her first full year at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and her school adventures. When [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) asks her to run an errand to the Barrys' house at twilight, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) terrifiedly confesses that she and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) imagined the spruce grove to be haunted. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) forces [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk through the [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood) alone as a lesson, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) deeply frightened but cured of her ghost-imagining habit.

## CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Carrie Sloane](../character/carrie-sloane.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Minnie Andrews](../character/minnie-andrews.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Superintendent Bell](../character/superintendent-bell.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home emotional on the last day of school as Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) makes his farewell speech to the students. Soon after, the community welcomes a new minister, Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and his young wife, who quickly become beloved in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) make elaborate preparations at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to host the Allans for tea, but when Anne's proudly baked layer cake is finally served, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) tastes something terribly wrong with it.

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decorates the tea table beautifully to impress the minister, Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and his wife. ## CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Allan](../character/allan.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Lauretta](../character/lauretta.md), [Katie Maurice](../character/katie-maurice.md), [Violetta](../character/violetta.md), [Thomas](../character/thomas.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home thrilled to receive an invitation to tea at the manse from Mrs. Allan. She returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in high spirits, recounting her evening to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and sharing news of the new female schoolteacher, Miss Muriel [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Carrie Sloane](../character/carrie-sloane.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Superintendent Bell](../character/superintendent-bell.md)** — During a game of dares at Diana's party, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attempts to walk the ridgepole of the Barrys' kitchen roof and falls, breaking her ankle. During her seven weeks of bed rest, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is comforted by visits from her schoolmates, friends, and neighbors.

## CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Carrie Sloane](../character/carrie-sloane.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and blossoms under the encouraging guidance of her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). ## CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid

## CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends re-enact a poem by having [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) float down the pond in a flat-bottomed boat, but the boat begins to sink, forcing her to cling to a bridge pile. [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) rows by and rescues her, but when he offers an apology and asks to be friends, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) haughtily refuses. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) on the dangers of being overly romantic.

After three agonizing weeks of waiting back home at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) brings the published pass list showing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tied for first place on the Island. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares the joyful news with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), and ends her night with a thankful prayer for her future.

At the event, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) suffers from severe stage fright upon facing the elegant audience and seeing professional performers. However, after spotting [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the crowd, she finds her resolve, performs wonderfully, receives an encore, and enjoys a triumphant evening.

## Chapter 40
